title: Film Thickness Measurement - Pattern Defects Detection on ATL/LMS IPRO8
subtitle: Post-Anneal Quality Validation for 7nm Node Manufacturing
author: Dr. Yuki Tanaka

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the ATL/LMS IPRO8 system to detect and classify Pattern Defects defects during post-anneal inspection at the 7nm technology node. The test is conducted at Milpitas Fab A to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 450mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Pattern Defects defects that are critical to yield at the 7nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the ATL/LMS IPRO8 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: ATL/LMS IPRO8
- Inspection Type: Film Thickness Measurement
- Target Defect: Pattern Defects
- Process Step: Post-Anneal
- Wafer Size: 450mm
- Technology Node: 7nm
- Fab Location: Milpitas Fab A

This test case applies to all ATL/LMS IPRO8 systems deployed at Milpitas Fab A for post-anneal monitoring in the 7nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: ATL/LMS IPRO8
Software Version: v9.0.864
Recipe: FILM_THICKNESS_MEASUREMENT_7nm_POST_ANNEAL
Illumination Mode: Darkfield
Scan Speed: Medium (76 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.25μm
Edge Exclusion: 2mm
Sampling Plan: Full wafer sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the ATL/LMS IPRO8 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'Film Thickness Measurement' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Pattern Defects defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 7nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 97 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 96% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±2.2% for Film Thickness Measurement
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.99 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2025-02-03
Wafers Tested: 18
Total Defects Found: 3375
Defect Density: 1074.3 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 1.8%
Capture Rate: 92.5%
Test Duration: 227 minutes
System Uptime: 98.1%

Result Classification: FAIL
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The ATL/LMS IPRO8 demonstrated below-target performance in detecting Pattern Defects at the 7nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate is within acceptable limits.

d) Edge-zone defect detection showed improved performance compared to previous revision.

e) Statistical process control charts showed stable performance over the test period.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Re-tune detection algorithm thresholds for Pattern Defects at 7nm node.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Escalate to R&D for algorithm enhancement if re-tuning does not resolve sensitivity gap.
